note: A false negative of the Radar: `build-gate.yml` runs on pull_request_target and calls `acceptance-tests.yml` with `secrets: inherit`, whose job checks out the fork head and runs `make acceptance` with every secret and `contents: write`; environment `build-gate` does not exist and `development` has no rule, so anyone who opens a pull request reaches it (a Critical path that must exist), and the setup-go cache it writes is restored by the tag release, the High cache path judged real. No job here declares cache-mode, so GitHub keeps the cache of every low-trust run read-only and grants no job cache write: ISSUE-705 is silent and no cache path exists, so the cache ceiling admits none.
